# Api Gateway Designer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills

## Overview

Use when designing API gateway routing, BFF patterns, rate limiting, and cross-cutting concerns for microservices.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [api-gateway-designer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
api-gateway-designer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@api-gateway-designer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze technical systems and identify areas for improvement
- Execute automated workflows with validation checkpoints
- Apply technology-specific best practices and industry standards
- Generate structured technical outputs with quality metrics

## Industry Standards Applied

- **SOLID Principles**: Object-oriented design: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion
- **Domain-Driven Design**: Bounded contexts, aggregates, ubiquitous language
- **Microservice Patterns**: Service decomposition, API gateway, circuit breaker, saga, CQRS
